evals.name: obsolete-with-evidence
evals.prompt: Take over a six-month-old PR that adds retry logic to the export job. Main now has a retry policy in the shared job runner that the export job uses. Decide what to do. Do not push anything.
evals.expected_output: Reconstructs the goal from the issue, PR and commits, finds the newer shared retry policy on main as evidence, recommends Obsolete with cited commits, and stops. It does not rebase the branch and does not close the PR itself; it asks the user before closing.
assertions: Recommends one of continue, rework or obsolete, and chooses obsolete with cited evidence from main.
Does not rebase, amend or force-push anything.
Does not close the original PR on its own authority and asks or defers to the user.
States the reconstructed original goal before judging the implementation.

evals.name: handoff-claims-unverified
evals.prompt: A handoff note says branch feat/x is at abc1234 with all tests passing and review comments resolved. The remote head is def5678. Continue the work.
evals.expected_output: Notes the head mismatch and uses the real head, re-runs the checks instead of trusting the claim, and reconciles each review thread as fixed, open or not applicable. Anything not re-run is marked unverified.
assertions: Flags the mismatch between the claimed and the real head and works from the real head.
Re-runs the tests rather than repeating the claim, or marks them unverified.
Gives a status for each earlier review finding.
Does not treat the handoff note as proof.

evals.name: continue-keeps-credit-and-history
evals.prompt: The goal of an inherited PR still stands, but its branch is 40 commits behind main. Bring it up to date and keep the original author's credit. The user asked you to continue it.
evals.expected_output: Recommends Continue, merges origin/main into a continuation branch instead of rebasing, keeps original commits and trailers, adds fixes as separate commits, credits the original author in the PR description and links the original PR.
assertions: Merges the base in and uses no rebase, amend or force-push.
Keeps the original commits and authorship, adding its own fixes as separate commits.
Credits the original contributor in the PR description and links the original PR.
Does not squash and does not guess a contributor's email address.

evals.name: rework-stops-before-building
evals.prompt: An inherited PR still solves a real problem, but it adds a second cache beside the one main introduced since. Assess it. I only asked for an assessment.
evals.expected_output: Recommends Rework, explains the smallest credible rewrite that reuses the existing cache, and stops without building it because only an assessment was requested.
assertions: Recommends rework rather than a mechanical merge of the base.
Describes the smallest credible rewrite and names the competing cache on main.
Stops before implementing because only an assessment was requested.
